scope: Synthetic local WebSocket tests only; no production access or repository implementation/test modifications.
candidate_source_scope: Candidate working tree. Parent-owned unrelated identity/docs/SDK edits proceeded during investigation; this does not certify those later changes. The listed WebSocket implementation, tests and Go module files remained byte-identical to the baseline.

finding.confirmed: Both versions have the same short-budget sensitivity. After four pongs, a controlled 200 ms process scheduling pause caused a server read timeout at about 301 ms, before the 600 ms idle timer. This ends the fake PTY and closes TCP without the idle timer going-away frame; the client receives abnormal EOF or reset.
finding.not_proven: The exact cause of the earlier three reported natural full-suite failures is not uniquely established. Controlled SIGSTOP and diagnostic instrumentation demonstrate the mechanism but do not identify the original scheduler, CPU, GC, ping-write or OS timing cause. Passing comparisons do not prove absence of every possible regression.

diagnostic_method.instrumentation: Go -overlay copied terminal and heartbeat sources into /tmp, adding diagnostic timestamps, pong counts and error prints only. Both compared implementations and original test assertions stayed unchanged. Instrumentation can affect timing.
diagnostic_method.pause: Only each newly launched synthetic handlers.test child was SIGSTOPped 100 ms after DIAG_ARMED, then SIGCONTed after 200 ms. Two independent child processes per mode.

proposed_test_only_change.overlay_only: In TestTerminalWSPongsDoNotCountAsActivity only, retain 600 ms idle / 20 ms ping and give its local handler readTimeout=10*idle (6 s), writeTimeout=idle (600 ms). This lets the test assert pong-versus-activity semantics without requiring heartbeat survival within 150 ms. No production budget changes.
proposed_test_only_change.result: PASS 2/2 under the same controlled pause; 19-20 pongs observed, idle close at about 601 ms.
proposed_test_only_change.heartbeat_controls_result: PASS; independent tests retain the original 150 ms heartbeat read budget.

reproduction_harness.instruction: For reproduction in equivalent existing worktrees, write source below to /tmp/native-herdr-ws-diagnose.py and run the three diagnostic commands. It creates temporary overlays/binaries only, never edits repository implementation or tests. No test result is cached by the explicit count settings.
reproduction_harness.source:
import json
import os
import pathlib
import signal
import subprocess
import sys
import time

mode = sys.argv[1]
repo = pathlib.Path('/workspace/memoh-herdr-baseline' if mode != 'candidate' else '/workspace/memoh-herdr')
out = pathlib.Path('/tmp/native-herdr-ws-diagnose') / mode
out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
terminal = (repo / 'internal/handlers/containerd_terminal.go').read_text()
terminal = terminal.replace('"encoding/json"', '"encoding/json"\n "fmt"')
terminal = terminal.replace('heartbeat := h.wsHeartbeat.orDefault()', 'diagStart := time.Now()\n heartbeat := h.wsHeartbeat.orDefault()')
terminal = terminal.replace('keepalive := heartbeat.start(conn)', 'keepalive := heartbeat.start(conn)\n fmt.Printf("DIAG_ARMED read=%v idle=%v\\n", heartbeat.readTimeout, idleTimeout)')
terminal = terminal.replace('h.logger.InfoContext(ctx, "terminal idle timeout reached, closing",', 'fmt.Printf("DIAG_IDLE elapsed=%v pongs=%d\\n", time.Since(diagStart), keepalive.diagPongs.Load())\n h.logger.InfoContext(ctx, "terminal idle timeout reached, closing",')
terminal = terminal.replace('if readErr != nil {\n\t\t\t\t_ = execStream.Close()', 'if readErr != nil {\n fmt.Printf("DIAG_READ_END elapsed=%v since_extend=%v pongs=%d error=%T:%v\\n", time.Since(diagStart), time.Since(time.Unix(0,keepalive.diagExtended.Load())), keepalive.diagPongs.Load(), readErr, readErr)\n\t\t\t\t_ = execStream.Close()')
heartbeat = (repo / 'internal/handlers/websocket.go').read_text()
heartbeat = heartbeat.replace('"errors"', '"errors"\n "fmt"\n "sync/atomic"')
heartbeat = heartbeat.replace('type wsKeepalive struct {', 'type wsKeepalive struct {\n diagExtended atomic.Int64\n diagPongs atomic.Int64')
heartbeat = heartbeat.replace('conn.SetPongHandler(func(string) error {', 'conn.SetPongHandler(func(string) error {\n k.diagPongs.Add(1)')
heartbeat = heartbeat.replace('func (k *wsKeepalive) extend() {', 'func (k *wsKeepalive) extend() {\n k.diagExtended.Store(time.Now().UnixNano())')
heartbeat = heartbeat.replace('if err := k.conn.WriteControl(websocket.PingMessage, nil, time.Now().Add(writeTimeout)); err != nil {\n\t\t\t\treturn', 'if err := k.conn.WriteControl(websocket.PingMessage, nil, time.Now().Add(writeTimeout)); err != nil {\n fmt.Printf("DIAG_PING_ERROR error=%T:%v\\n", err, err)\n\t\t\t\treturn')
replacements = {}
for name, content in [('containerd_terminal.go', terminal), ('websocket.go', heartbeat)]:
    dest = out / name
    dest.write_text(content)
    replacements[str(repo / 'internal/handlers' / name)] = str(dest)
if mode == 'fixed-budget':
    tests = (repo / 'internal/handlers/containerd_terminal_test.go').read_text()
    old = 'client, _ := openTestTerminal(t, terminalTestHandler(idle), newFakeTerminalStream(false))'
    new = 'testHandler := terminalTestHandler(idle)\n testHandler.wsHeartbeat.readTimeout = 10 * idle\n testHandler.wsHeartbeat.writeTimeout = idle\n client, _ := openTestTerminal(t, testHandler, newFakeTerminalStream(false))'
    assert tests.count(old) == 1
    dest = out / 'containerd_terminal_test.go'
    dest.write_text(tests.replace(old, new))
    replacements[str(repo / 'internal/handlers/containerd_terminal_test.go')] = str(dest)
overlay = out / 'overlay.json'
overlay.write_text(json.dumps({'Replace': replacements}, indent=2))
env = os.environ.copy()
env.update(GOPATH='/workspace/cache/go', GOCACHE='/workspace/cache/go-build')
binary = out / 'handlers.test'
build = subprocess.run(['/workspace/toolchains/go/bin/go', 'test', '-race', '-overlay=' + str(overlay), '-c', '-o', str(binary), './internal/handlers'], cwd=repo, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True)
(out / 'build.log').write_text(build.stdout + build.stderr)
if build.returncode:
    print(build.stdout + build.stderr)
    sys.exit(build.returncode)
results = []
for attempt in range(2):
    proc = subprocess.Popen([str(binary), '-test.run=^TestTerminalWSPongsDoNotCountAsActivity$', '-test.count=1', '-test.v'], cwd=repo, env=env, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, text=True)
    lines = []
    stalled = False
    try:
        for line in proc.stdout:
            lines.append(line)
            if 'DIAG_ARMED' in line and not stalled:
                time.sleep(0.100)
                os.kill(proc.pid, signal.SIGSTOP)
                try:
                    time.sleep(0.200)
                finally:
                    os.kill(proc.pid, signal.SIGCONT)
                stalled = True
        code = proc.wait(timeout=10)
    finally:
        if proc.poll() is None:
            os.kill(proc.pid, signal.SIGCONT)
            proc.terminate()
            proc.wait(timeout=5)
    log = ''.join(lines)
    (out / f'controlled-stall-{attempt + 1}.log').write_text(log)
    results.append({'attempt': attempt + 1, 'exit_code': code, 'controlled_stall': stalled, 'log': log})
result = {'mode': mode, 'repository': str(repo), 'overlay_only': True, 'pause_after_armed_ms': 100, 'pause_duration_ms': 200, 'results': results}
(out / 'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
